added.name: BoolCircuit.decodeNat_false_cons
added.header: (r : List Bool) : decodeNat (false :: r) = some (0, r)

added.name: BoolCircuit.decodeNat_nil
added.header: : decodeNat [] = none

added.name: BoolCircuit.decodeNat_true_cons
added.header: (r : List Bool) : decodeNat (true :: r) = (decodeNat r).map fun p => (p.1 + 1, p.2)

added.name: BoolCircuit.encodeNat_def
added.header: (k : ℕ) : encodeNat k = (List.replicate k true ++ [false])

added.name: Complexity.BinArith.beq_def
added.header: (z : List Bool) : beq z = (decide (bitsVal (pairFstD z) = bitsVal (pairSndD z)))

added.name: Complexity.BinArith.encWords_def
added.header: (L : List (List Bool)) : encWords L = (L.flatMap (fun w => pairEncode w []))

added.name: Complexity.NUPPT.computes_iff
added.header: (f : List Bool → List Bool) : A.Computes f ↔ ∀ n y (r : A.Coins n), A.runAt n y r = f (advInput n y)

added.name: Complexity.NUPPT.inverter_def
added.header: (A : NUPPT) (n ℓ m : ℕ) (y : Fin m → Bool) (r : A.Coins n) : A.inverter n ℓ m y r = decodeFin ℓ (A.runAt n (List.ofFn y) r)

added.name: Complexity.NUPPT.ofPolyTimeUniform_def
added.header: {f : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : PolyTimeComputable f) (coins : PolyExpr) : (ofPolyTimeUniform hf coins : NUPPT) = (ofPolyTime hf coins (.const 0) (fun _ => []) (fun _ => by simp))

added.name: Complexity.NUPPT.runLit_eq
added.header: (y : List Bool) (r : A.Coins y.length) : A.runLit y r = A.runAt y.length y r

added.name: Complexity.NUPPT.timeBound_def
added.header: (m : ℕ) : timeBound A m = (A.Ct * (m + 1) ^ A.ct)

added.name: Complexity.PPT.toNUPPT_mk
added.header: (A : NUPPT) (h : A.Uniform) : toNUPPT ⟨A, h⟩ = A

added.name: Complexity.P_def
added.header: : P = (⋃ c : ℕ, DTIME fun n => n ^ c + 1)

added.name: Complexity.PolyExpr.normal_def
added.header: (C c : ℕ) : normal C c = (mul (const C) (pow (add var (const 1)) c))

added.name: Complexity.PrefixByLength.drop_def
added.header: (z : List Bool) : drop z = ((pairSndD z).drop (pairFstD z).length)

added.name: Complexity.PrefixByLength.take_def
added.header: (z : List Bool) : take z = ((pairSndD z).take (pairFstD z).length)

added.name: Complexity.StateLoop.polyTimeComputable_stateIterate
added.header: {start step out : List Bool → List Bool} (hstart : PolyTimeComputable start) (hstep : PolyTimeComputable step) (hout : PolyTimeComputable out) (B : PolyExpr) : PolyTimeComputable fun x => out ((StateLoop.gstep step B)^[(pairEncode x (start x)).length] (pairEncode x (start x)))

added.name: Complexity.blockAt_def
added.header: (a k : ℕ) (z : List Bool) (i : ℕ) : blockAt a k z i = (((pairSndD z).drop (i * (a * ((pairFstD z).length + 1) ^ k))).take (a * ((pairFstD z).length + 1) ^ k))

added.name: Complexity.isNilB_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : isNilB w = (decide (w = []))

added.name: Complexity.polyBound_iff
added.header: (p : ℕ → ℕ) : PolyBound p ↔ ∃ C c : ℕ, ∀ n, p n ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c

added.name: Complexity.polyTimeComputable_iff
added.header: (f : List Bool → List Bool) : PolyTimeComputable f ↔ ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (C c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime f fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ c

added.name: Complexity.polyTimeReducible_iff
added.header: (L L' : Language Bool) : PolyTimeReducible L L' ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ L ↔ f x ∈ L'

added.name: Language.inPPoly_iff_inSIZE
added.header: (L : Language Bool) : L.InPPoly ↔ ∃ a k : ℕ, L.InSIZE (fun n => a * (n + 1) ^ k)

added.name: Language.inSIZE_iff
added.header: (T : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Language Bool) : L.InSIZE T ↔ ∃ C : BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily, C.HasFaninTwo ∧ (∀ n, (C.circuit n).size ≤ T n) ∧ C.language = L

added.name: Randomized.anyVerifier_def
added.header: (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (p k : ℕ → ℕ) : anyVerifier M p k = (fun x r => (List.range (k x.length)).any fun i => M x ((r.drop (i * p x.length)).take (p x.length)) : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)

added.name: Randomized.boolVerifier_def
added.header: (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) : boolVerifier M = (fun x r => some (M x r) : List Bool → List Bool → Option Bool)

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderAnswerIs_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderAnswerIs E ↔ ∀ M b, E.Eff M → E.Eff (boolVerifier fun x r => M x r = some b)

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderAny_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderAny E ↔ ∀ M a k a' k', E.Eff (boolVerifier M) → E.Eff (boolVerifier (anyVerifier M (polyLen a k) (polyLen a' k')))

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderMajority_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderMajority E ↔ ∀ M a k a' k', E.Eff (boolVerifier M) → E.Eff (boolVerifier (majorityVerifier M (polyLen a k) (polyLen a' k')))

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderNot_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderNot E ↔ ∀ M, E.Eff (boolVerifier M) → E.Eff (boolVerifier fun x r => !(M x r))

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderRace_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderRace E ↔ ∀ M₁ M₂ a k, E.Eff (boolVerifier M₁) → E.Eff (boolVerifier M₂) → E.Eff (raceVerifier M₁ M₂ (polyLen a k))

added.name: Randomized.closedUnderShiftOr_iff
added.header: : ClosedUnderShiftOr E ↔ ∀ M a k a' k', E.Eff (boolVerifier M) → E.EffTwoWitness (shiftOrVerifier M (polyLen a k) (polyLen a' k'))

added.name: Randomized.inPi2_iff
added.header: (L : Language Bool) : InPi2 E L ↔ InSigma2 E Lᶜ

added.name: Randomized.inSigma2_iff
added.header: (L : Language Bool) : InSigma2 E L ↔ ∃ (N : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ), E.EffTwoWitness N ∧ ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔ ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length ∧ ∀ v : List Bool, v.length = polyLen a₂ k₂ x.length → N x u v = true

added.name: Randomized.majorityVerifier_def
added.header: (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (p k : ℕ → ℕ) : majorityVerifier M p k = (fun x r => let n := x.length let votes := (List.range (k n)).countP fun i => M x ((r.drop (i * p n)).take (p n)) k n < 2 * votes : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)

added.name: Randomized.polyLen_def
added.header: (a k : ℕ) : polyLen a k = (fun n => a * (n + 1) ^ k : ℕ → ℕ)

added.name: Randomized.raceVerifier_def
added.header: (M₁ M₂ : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (p₁ : ℕ → ℕ) : raceVerifier M₁ M₂ p₁ = (fun x r => if M₁ x (r.take (p₁ x.length)) then some true else if M₂ x (r.drop (p₁ x.length)) then some false else none : List Bool → List Bool → Option Bool)

added.name: Randomized.shiftOrVerifier_def
added.header: (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (p k : ℕ → ℕ) : shiftOrVerifier M p k = (fun x u v => (List.range (k x.length)).any fun i => M x (List.zipWith xor v ((u.drop (i * p x.length)).take (p x.length))) : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool → Bool)

added.name: Randomized.verifierHasCircuits_iff
added.header: (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (p : ℕ → ℕ) : VerifierHasCircuits M p ↔ ∃ a k : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : List Bool), r.length = p n → ∃ D : DAGCircuit n, D.IsWellFormed ∧ D.IsFaninTwo ∧ D.size ≤ a * (n + 1) ^ k ∧ ∀ v : Fin n → Bool, D.eval v = M (List.ofFn v) r

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.argX_eq
added.header: (w : List Bool) : argX w = pairFstD (pairFstD (NUPPT.inArg w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.checkRep_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : checkRep Com ℓ w t = (checkStr Com (LOf ℓ w) (nOf w) (mOf w) (argX w) (pairFstD (pairSndD^[2 * t] (argM w))) (pairFstD (pairSndD^[2 * t + 1] (argM w))) (eRep w t))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.checkStr_def
added.header: (L n m : ℕ) (x com opn : List Bool) (e : ℕ) : checkStr Com L n m x com opn e = (let j := nthTrue x (n * n) (e % m) let a := colorVal (pairFstD (pairFstD opn)) 0 let ri := pairSndD (pairFstD opn) let b := colorVal (pairFstD (pairSndD opn)) 0 let rj := pairSndD (pairSndD opn) decide (ri.length = L ∧ rj.length = L ∧ Com (pairEncode (padTo n (encColorOfVal a)) ri) = pairFstD (pairSndD^[j / n] com) ∧ Com (pairEncode (padTo n (encColorOfVal b)) rj) = pairFstD (pairSndD^[j % n] com) ∧ a ≠ b))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.ilayout_def
added.header: (x z : List Bool) (hist : List (List Bool)) (r : List Bool) : ilayout x z hist r = (NUPPT.layout (List.replicate x.length true) (pairEncode (pairEncode x z) (Strategy.encodeMsgs hist)) [] r)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.proverCoinsOf_def
added.header: (N : ℕ) : proverCoinsOf ℓ N = (3 * N + N * ℓ.eval N)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.proverRepStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : proverRepStr Com ℓ w = (let h := histLen (argM w) let c := proverCoinsOf ℓ (argX w).length if h / 2 < nOf w * mOf w then proverStr Com ℓ (NUPPT.layout (List.replicate (argX w).length true) (pairEncode (pairEncode (argX w) (argZ w)) (if h % 2 = 0 then [] else pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD^[h - 1] (argM w))) [])) [] (((NUPPT.inCoins w).drop (h / 2 * c)).take c)) else [])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.proverStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : proverStr Com ℓ w = (if argM w = [] then commitStr Com ℓ w else if mOf w = 0 then [] else openStr ℓ w)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.verdictRepStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : verdictRepStr Com ℓ w = (decide (argX w = (argX w).take (nOf w * nOf w)) && (decide (mOf w = 0) || (decide (2 ≤ nOf w) && decide (firstIdx (fun t => !checkRep Com ℓ w t) (nOf w * mOf w) = nOf w * mOf w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.verdictStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : verdictStr Com ℓ w = (decide (argX w = (argX w).take (nOf w * nOf w)) && (decide (mOf w = 0) || (decide (2 ≤ nOf w) && checkStr Com (LOf ℓ w) (nOf w) (mOf w) (argX w) (pairFstD (argM w)) (pairFstD (pairSndD (argM w))) (eOf w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.verifierRepStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : verifierRepStr Com ℓ w = (let h := histLen (argM w) if h % 2 = 1 then (if h / 2 < nOf w * mOf w then List.replicate (eRep w (h / 2)) true else []) else if h = 2 * ((argX w).length * (argX w).length) then [verdictRepStr Com ℓ w] else [])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColMachines.verifierStr_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : verifierStr Com ℓ w = (if argM w = [] then [false] else if pairSndD (argM w) = [] then List.replicate (eOf w) true else if pairSndD (pairSndD (argM w)) = [] then [verdictStr Com ℓ w] else [false])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimLemmas.mergeAt_def
added.header: {m ℓ : ℕ} (p : Fin m × Fin m) (a b : Fin m → Fin ℓ → Bool) : (mergeAt p a b : Fin m → Fin ℓ → Bool) = (fun i => if i = p.1 ∨ i = p.2 then a i else b i : Fin m → Fin ℓ → Bool)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.attemptNum_def
added.header: (Com : List Bool → List Bool) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (V' : Strategy) (x z blk : List Bool) : attemptNum Com ℓ V' x z blk = (if mE x = 0 then some (View.encode ⟨x, z, rVStr ℓ x blk, [comStr Com ℓ x blk (fun _ => 0), []]⟩) else if (V'.next x z (rVStr ℓ x blk) [comStr Com ℓ x blk (colorNum x blk)]).length % mE x = eIdx x blk then some (View.encode ⟨x, z, rVStr ℓ x blk, [comStr Com ℓ x blk (colorNum x blk), opnStr ℓ x blk]⟩) else none)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.colorA_def
added.header: (v : ℕ) : colorA v = (if h : v < 6 then (pair6Equiv ⟨v, h⟩).1.1 else 0)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.colorB_def
added.header: (v : ℕ) : colorB v = (if h : v < 6 then (pair6Equiv ⟨v, h⟩).1.2 else 1)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.colorNum_def
added.header: (x blk : List Bool) (i : ℕ) : colorNum x blk i = (if i = kPos x blk / nV x then colorA (vIdx x blk) else if i = kPos x blk % nV x then colorB (vIdx x blk) else 0)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.countBits_def
added.header: (x : List Bool) (k : ℕ) : countBits x k = (((List.range k).filter fun j => x.getD j false).length)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.eIdx_def
added.header: (x blk : List Bool) : eIdx x blk = (sampleEdgeIdx (mE x) x.length blk)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.polyTimeComputable_next
added.header: {V' : Strategy} (hV' : V'.Efficient) {X Z R C : List Bool → List Bool} (hX : PolyTimeComputable X) (hZ : PolyTimeComputable Z) (hR : PolyTimeComputable R) (hC : PolyTimeComputable C) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => V'.next (X w) (Z w) (R w) [C w]

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.rVStr_def
added.header: (ℓ : PolyExpr) (x blk : List Bool) : rVStr ℓ x blk = (blk.drop (baseR x + x.length * ℓ.eval x.length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.rrStr_def
added.header: (ℓ : PolyExpr) (x blk : List Bool) (i : ℕ) : rrStr ℓ x blk i = (EnsembleLemmas.padL (ℓ.eval (nV x)) (blk.drop (baseR x + i * ℓ.eval (nV x))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.sampleNum_def
added.header: (m k T : ℕ) (r : List Bool) : sampleNum m k T r = (if trialIdx m k T r 0 < T then blockVal r (trialIdx m k T r 0 * k) k else m)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.ColSimMachine.sim_def
added.header: (Com : List Bool → List Bool) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (V' : Strategy) (x z r : List Bool) : sim Com ℓ V' x z r = (let B := (blockPoly ℓ V').eval x.length let att : ℕ → Option (List Bool) := fun t => attemptStr Com ℓ V' x z (colCoinSlice B t r) if edgeCount (decGraph x).2 = 0 then (att 0).getD [] else ((List.range (colIterations x)).findSome? att).getD [])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Collection.glPadSampleFun_def
added.header: (z : List Bool) : glPadSampleFun F z = (pairEncode (F.sample.output (NUPPT.layout (NUPPT.inParam z) (NUPPT.inArg z) [] ((pairSndD (pairEncode (NUPPT.inParam z) (NUPPT.inCoins z))).take (F.sample.coins.eval (pairFstD (pairEncode (NUPPT.inParam z) (NUPPT.inCoins z))).length)))) ((pairSndD (pairEncode (NUPPT.inParam z) (NUPPT.inCoins z))).drop (F.sample.coins.eval (pairFstD (pairEncode (NUPPT.inParam z) (NUPPT.inCoins z))).length)))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.EncodingMachines.CountLoop.acc_def
added.header: (N : List Bool → ℕ) (w : List Bool) : acc N w = (decide (N (pairFstD w) ≤ (pairFstD (pairSndD w)).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.EncodingMachines.CountLoop.out_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : out w = (pairSndD (pairSndD w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.EnsembleLemmas.blocks_eq
added.header: (q ℓ : ℕ) : blocks q ℓ = FunFamily.blocks q ℓ

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.acc_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : acc D q w = (!(isQ D q w) || decide ((unQ q w).length ≤ (rnd w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.advD_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : advD w = (pairSndD (NUPPT.inAdvice (inX w)))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.ans_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : ans E D q w = (ggmEval E (pairEncode (lab E D q w) ((query D q w).drop (unI w).length).tail))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.bound_def
added.header: : bound q = (.add (.mul q (.add (.mul (.const 28) .var) (.const 27))) (.const 6))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.chal_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : chal w = (NUPPT.inArg (inX w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.cnt'_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : cnt' D q w = (if notFound D q w then true :: cnt w else cnt w)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.cnt_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : cnt w = (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (inS w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.coinsAll_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : coinsAll w = (NUPPT.inCoins (inX w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.coinsD_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : coinsD q w = ((coinsRest q w).drop ((PolyExpr.mul q (.mul (.const 2) .var)).eval (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.coinsRest_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : coinsRest q w = ((coinsAll w).drop ((PolyExpr.mul q .var).eval (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.eqJ_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : eqJ w = (decide ((cnt w).length = (unJ w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.fresh_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : fresh E q w = (if ltJ w then ((pairs q w).drop (mul2 w).length).take (un2 w).length else if eqJ w then chal w else E (((seeds q w).drop (mul1 w).length).take (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.hist'_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : hist' E D q w = (hist w ++ pairEncode (pairEncode (query D q w) (ans E D q w)) [])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.hist_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : hist w = (pairFstD (inS w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.inS_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : inS w = (pairSndD w)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.inX_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : inX w = (pairFstD w)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.isQ_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : isQ D q w = (decide (pairFstD (move D q w) = [false]) && decide ((pairSndD (move D q w)).length = (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.lab_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : lab E D q w = (selHalf (((query D q w).drop (unI w).length).headD false) (paramU w) (vstr E D q w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.look_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : look D q w = (lookup (pairEncode (pfx D q w) (tbl w)))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.ltJ_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : ltJ w = (!decide ((unJ w).length ≤ (cnt w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.move_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : move D q w = (D.output (NUPPT.layout (paramU w) (hist w) (advD w) (coinsD q w)))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.mul1_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : mul1 w = (List.replicate ((paramU w).length * (cnt w).length) true)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.mul2_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : mul2 w = (List.replicate ((un2 w).length * (cnt w).length) true)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.notFound_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : notFound D q w = (decide (look D q w = []))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.out_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : out D q w = (if isQ D q w then [false] else [verdictOf (move D q w)])

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.pairs_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : pairs q w = ((coinsRest q w).take ((PolyExpr.mul q (.mul (.const 2) .var)).eval (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.paramU_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : paramU w = (NUPPT.inParam (inX w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.pfx_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : pfx D q w = ((query D q w).take (unI w).length)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.query_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : query D q w = (pairSndD (move D q w))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.rawFun_def
added.header: : rawFun E D q = (stateLoopFun start (step E D q) (acc D q) (out D q) q (bound q))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.rnd_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : rnd w = (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (inS w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.seeds_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : seeds q w = ((coinsAll w).take ((PolyExpr.mul q .var).eval (paramU w).length))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.step_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : step E D q w = (pairEncode (hist' E D q w) (pairEncode (tbl' E D q w) (pairEncode (cnt' D q w) (true :: rnd w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.tbl'_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : tbl' E D q w = (if notFound D q w then tbl w ++ pairEncode (pairEncode (pfx D q w) (fresh E q w)) [] else tbl w)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.tbl_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : tbl w = (pairFstD (pairSndD (inS w)))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.un2_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : un2 w = (List.replicate ((PolyExpr.mul (.const 2) .var).eval (paramU w).length) true)

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.unI_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : unI w = (pairFstD (pairFstD (NUPPT.inAdvice (inX w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.unJ_def
added.header: (w : List Bool) : unJ w = (pairSndD (pairFstD (NUPPT.inAdvice (inX w))))

added.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.GGMRed.unQ_def
